text:
Lu: kicking off onboarding for zenith-13b-v1 (hf/zenith/zenith-13b-v1). customer POC, latency-sensitive, want Dedicated later. main asks: quant experiments (q4_0 + q3_a), runtime RoPE compatibility, kv-cache semantics. putting up a minimal gating checklist so eng-runtime can triage.

Kiara: thanks — can you enumerate the gating items? especially anything that must fail-fast for canary.

Lu: sure, thinking fast smoke: 
```
- model loads on x64 + aarch64 machines (FP16 + int8 attempt)
- token generation end-to-end (max_tokens=256) without hangs
- rotary/RoPE alignment check vs HF reference (step-wise logits diff < 1e-3 on short seqs)
- kv-cache warm/cold behavior: resume generation after context swap
- quantized local: q4_0 no NaNs and p50 latency within 1.5x fp16
- deterministic sampling with fixed seed (seeded topk)
```

Matt: add: evaluate prefix caching correctness with progressive prompts (simulate chat). I saw a previous model where rotary mismatch only appears after many prompt swaps.

Drew: for prioritization — customer timeline: demo in 10 days. Recommend priority=high but we gate on conv-quality (toxicity/regression) and runtime stability. Do we have eval sets?

Lu: yes, @Kiara will upload convo evals (100 prompt pairs, expected logits/answers). adding unit tests: small seq(32) vs long seq(1024) rolling kv eviction.

Kiara: uploaded evals to gs://redwood-evals/zenith13b/quickset-2026-03-18. also added an 'attention-smoke' harness that runs: 
```bash
python tests/attention_smoke.py --model hf/zenith/zenith-13b-v1 --seqs 32,1024 --seed 42
```

Lu: engbot created canary cluster zenith-13b-canary-189765. can we run q4_0 compile and a non-quant baseline? @engbot any constraints?

engbot: Canary created. resources: 2xA100-p4, mem 64G. Compile targets queued: fp16, q4_0, q3_a. Canary TTL 6 hours. Use tag zenith-canary-189765.

Matt: running fp16 smoke now. quick logs: 
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:02Z] load ok, mem footprint 13.2GB
[2026-03-18T14:12:05Z] gen p50=78ms p99=312ms (seq=32)
[2026-03-18T14:12:07Z] rotary check diff max=2.3e-4
```
Looks fine so far.

Drew: q4_0 compile started. note: previous q4_0 of other models had subtle fp->int roundoff affecting logit ordering for close tokens. we should run the ranked-replace test (topk reorder sensitivity).

Lu: added ranked-replace harness to the checklist. also flagging: if kv-cache resume gives >1e-2 avg logit drift we fail gating.

Kiara: q4_0 run finished — smoke shows no NaNs but logits drift for long seqs: avg L2 drift ~0.018 on 1024 seq (threshold 0.01). attaching quick diff: 
```
- fps: fp16 top1: "Paris"
- q4_0 top1: "Pari"
- note: subtle truncation in tokenization boundary case
```

Matt: that's concerning. could be rotary scaling or our int8 matmul kernel. repro on CPU reference?

Drew: repro on HF CPU (fp32) yields same as fp16 baseline. that suggests quant pipeline is the culprit. If we can't bring drift down to <0.01 we should fallback to fp16 for Dedicated customers.

Lu: agreed. action items: 
- ENG-RUNTIME (Matt) investigate q4_0 matmul kernels + rotary scaling mismatch (priority: now)
- ENG-ML (Kiara) run narrowed eval focusing on tokenization edge cases + add more seeds (24)
- DREW/product: notify customer about potential quant opt timing, keep demo but with fp16 fallback toggle in canary

Matt: started binary search on kernel params. early hypothesis: asymmetric scaling factor in per-row quant caused small bias on high-entropy tokens. running targeted test: 
```python
# small repro
A = load_weight_slice(...)
for scale in [0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25]:
    q = quantize(A, scale=scale)
    out = matmul(q, x)
    compare(out, fp16_out)
```

engbot: job matt/q4-debug-842 completed (runtime logs at gs://redwood-builds/189765/matt-q4-debug-842.log).

Kiara: after adding more seeds + tokenization edge cases, drift median drops to 0.009 for 1024 seqs (passed threshold) but worst-case still 0.012 on one prompt.

Lu: OK — we can mark gating as flaky-pass. Plan: require a runtime patch to reduce worst-case drift or default to fp16 for that prompt pattern. For canary: run mixed mode where q4_0 is default but fp16 fallback if drift>threshold for a specific prompt.

Drew: that's acceptable for demo. create a rollout plan: canary -> 5% dedicated -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback if regressions observed in eval set within 24h. add tracing metrics for topk reorder rate.

Matt: I'll put a PR for a scale-correction factor and unit test against the eval set. ETA 6h. tagging @ops-bot for longer canary if needed.

ops-bot: extended canary TTL by 12 hours as requested.

Lu: great. closing loop: please update the checklist doc with final gating decision and add the fallback flag in runtime config: `zenith.fallback_to_fp16_on_drift=true`. will reconvene post-PR review. :thumbsup:"
